@Roth.Θ_mono : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B B' : ℝ},
  1 ≤ B → B ≤ B' → ∀ (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ}, Roth.Θ B q r ≤ Roth.Θ B' q r

theorem Roth.Θ_mono.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B B' : ℝ},
  1 ≤ B → B ≤ B' → ∀ (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ}, Roth.Θ B q r ≤ Roth.Θ B' q r :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {B B'} hB hBB' q {r} ↦
  csSup_le_csSup (Roth.indexSet_bddAbove B' q) (Roth.indexSet_nonempty hB q r) fun ⦃a⦄ a_1 ↦
    Exists.casesOn a_1 fun R h ↦
      And.casesOn h fun left right ↦
        And.casesOn left fun hR0 right_1 ↦
          And.casesOn right_1 fun hRd hRc ↦
            Exists.casesOn right fun h h_1 ↦
              And.casesOn h_1 fun hh right ↦
                right ▸ Exists.intro R ⟨⟨hR0, ⟨hRd, fun d ↦ LE.le.trans (hRc d) hBB'⟩⟩, Exists.intro h ⟨hh, rfl⟩⟩

THETAMONO191_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B B' : ℝ},
  1 ≤ B → B ≤ B' → ∀ (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ}, Roth.Θ B q r ≤ Roth.Θ B' q r

@csSup_le_csSup : ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s t : Set α},
  BddAbove t → s.Nonempty → s ⊆ t → sSup s ≤ sSup t

@csSup_le_csSup' : ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot α] {s t : Set α},
  BddAbove t → s ⊆ t → sSup s ≤ sSup t
@Real.sSup_le : ∀ {s : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ}, (∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ a) → 0 ≤ a → sSup s ≤ a
